title: The Rise of Yawgmoth
summary: A physician gains control of Phyrexia and becomes an existential threat to Dominaria.
narrative: Yawgmoth gained influence during a crisis in the ancient Thran civilization. His ambition and increasingly ruthless medical experiments helped destabilize an already divided society.
With access to the artificial plane of Phyrexia, he established the foundations of an empire that would threaten Dominaria for thousands of years.
